# Partner Development Manager (PDM) Role at AWS

## Overview
A Partner Development Manager at AWS is responsible for recruiting, enabling, and growing relationships with AWS Partners (typically technology or consulting partners) to drive mutual business success.

## Key Responsibilities

### Partner Recruitment & Onboarding
- Identify and recruit new partners into the AWS Partner Network (APN)
- Guide partners through onboarding and certification processes
- Help partners achieve tier advancement (Select, Advanced, Premier)

### Business Development
- Develop joint go-to-market strategies with partners
- Create and execute partner business plans
- Drive revenue growth through partner channels
- Identify co-selling opportunities with AWS sales teams

### Partner Enablement
- Ensure partners complete technical training and certifications
- Help partners build AWS competencies and specializations
- Connect partners with AWS resources (funding, marketing, technical support)

### Relationship Management
- Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned partners
- Conduct regular business reviews
- Advocate internally for partner needs

## Skills Typically Required
- Sales/business development experience
- Understanding of cloud technologies
- Strong relationship-building abilities
- Experience in partner/channel ecosystems
- Strategic thinking and execution skills

## Common Variations
- **ISV PDM** - focuses on Independent Software Vendors
- **SI PDM** - focuses on System Integrators/Consulting partners
- **GSI PDM** - focuses on Global System Integrators

Would you like more details on any specific aspect?
